text: Captain Marvel and Billy Batson find themselves mysteriously projected into a topsy-turvy world where everything is backwards, upside-down, inside out and distorted— THE FANTASTICALLY UNBELIEVABLE REALM OF THE SUBCONSCIOUS!

Folks, sometimes I've been asked what was the MOST AMAZING adventure Captain Marvel ever had. Well— you know, Captain Marvel's been just about everywhere and done almost everything— but I think the most amazing thing that ever happened to him was— BUT WAIT! Here's how it all began.
I was walking home from the broadcasting studios rather late one night, when—
HELP! HELP! SAVE ME!
WH-WHAT'S THAT?
HEY! What are you doing down there?
HELP! HELP!
HELP! I'm falling!
SHAZAM!!
Lightning splits the air and—
—it's Captain Marvel to the rescue!
HELP! Help! Help!
Coming!
HELP!
Take it easy!
You ought to know better than to try a stunt like that!
Back we go!
I'm falling! I'm dizzy! HALP!
DIZZY!? Brother, you're in no condition to be out on the streets. I'd better take you home!
H-here— here's where I live!
WELL, let's go up the stairs!
Stairs! STAIRS? That's what started the whole thing! STAIRS! I can't get up them!
I'M FALLING!
H-HELP!!
He's passed out. Might as well carry him in and put him to bed.
I've done about all I can. And now— SHAZAM!
W-what was that? And WHO are you?
It's all right, mister, just lie back and you'll be all right in the morning!
NO! NO! Nothing will ever be right again! NOTHING! OOOOOOH! AH-HAH-HAH-HAH-HA!
HAH! HAA! HAA! Stairs! Stairs! Haaa!
HOLY MOLEY! The old fellow's throwing a fit!
I— I'm all right now!
WHEW! I'm glad THAT'S over.
Now suppose you tell me what this is all about— Mister— er—
Smith— PROFESSOR EDGEWOOD SMITH is my name, sonny.
Sometimes people call me "EDGEWISE" Smith. They think— they think I'm QUEER— and they're right— mostly. Look at this room of mine, for instance!
WOW! It makes me dizzy just to look at it!
Precisely! But now I'll show you a trick!
See? From this position it looks right!
We-ell, ALMOST right, anyhow!
See? When you first look— the stairs go UP. Then when you look again— they seem to go DOWN!
HMMM! So they do! Amazing!
Now here are SIX cubes! But turn the drawing upside down and there are SEVEN!
Now of course you can comb your hair in front of an ordinary mirror, can't you? Even though your reflection is really left-handed?
Why, sure— anybody can!
But when a SECOND mirror shows you as you REALLY are, you're all confused, aren't you?

See? It's all in your subconscious mind— HERE! You can't even read ordinary writing held to a mirror because it's backwards! And yet you comb your hair backwards and can't do it frontwards when the extra mirror shows you how you really are!
It's— it's all very confusing— I think I'd better go!
G-GOOD NIGHT, Professor.
Good night, sonny— watch those stairs!
WOW! What a crackpot that Professor "Edgewise" Smith is! And to think it's all in his SUBCONSCIOUS mind! I'm glad MY subconscious mind doesn't bother ME!
Little does Billy realize what is about to happen to him!
Some hours later—
HMMPH! I must have fallen out of bed! Well, it's time to get up anyway!
OW! What's that lighting fixture doing here in the middle of the floor?
HOLY MOLEY! Maybe it's happened to me like it did to Professor Smith! I'M— I'M UPSIDE DOWN!
YEEOW! I'd better get dressed and get out of here!
Omigosh! I can't even see my own face in the mirror any more!
Things certainly look queer! I don't blame old Professor Smith for getting dizzy!
AND THE PEOPLE! I wonder if I look like THAT to THEM!
THAT'S FUNNY! This elevator's going DOWN!
SIXTY-FIFTH FLOOR! SIXTY-FIVE! Let 'em out!
Why, good morning, Miss Dalshaw! How— er— NICE you look this morning!
Good morning, Billy. Mr. Morris wants to see you right away.
Good morning, Billy! All set for a good hard day's work at Amalgamated Broadcasting?
GOSH! What a costume! I must look funny in my plain old blue pants and red sweater!
Good morning, Mr. Morris.
Back in Billy's office...
ULP! I forgot I can't even see myself anymore!
GOSH! How am I gonna read these news reports? THEY'RE all mixed up, too!
IT'S NO USE! I can see it— but I still can't read it!
Come on, Billy— WE'RE OFF TO THE FRONT!
Wh— what front?
Why, the WAR FRONT, of course! The invasion and all! TO THE ROOF!
The INVASION? Here?
CLIMB IN, BILLY! HURRY!
But— but, Mr. Morris, if we're going to the FRONT, wouldn't it really be the BACK? Er— I mean— oh, I'M ALL TWISTED UP!
LOOK OUT! We're being attacked!
Even in this weird, twisted, upside-down-and-backward world, Billy finds men whose only thought is to kill without mercy!
We're out of control!! WE'RE FALLING!
SHAZAM!
In answer to Billy's desperate shout, the familiar flash of yellow lightning splits the air with a deafening report... and...
...good old Captain Marvel takes over!
Come on, Mr. Morris! I can handle the situation— if Billy can't!!
Here we are, safe— WUP! I'm STILL a little twisted! But after all, I'M more able to take this sort of thing than Billy Batson is!
Just where are we now, Mr. Morris?
Why— ah—
Surrender or be killed, dogs!
Come quietly and you will not be harmed, but I warn you....
SAVE YOUR WARNINGS FOR SOMEONE WHO NEEDS 'EM!
OH!
Bravo, Captain Marvel! We'll show 'em!
OW!
HELP!
Pull a gun on Captain Marvel, will you? NEXT TIME YOU'LL KNOW BETTER!
AND AS FOR YOU...
Wait, Captain Marvel... DON'T...
GREAT JUMPIN' JUPITER... A GIRL!
Yes, their leaders are all women!!
Come on, sister! YOU'RE going to take us to your leader! I'll soon put a stop to this female invasion!
FOLLOW ME!
You bet we'll follow you!
And don't try any tricks on US!
Hey! It's black in here!
Where'd that girl get to? SHE'S GIVEN US THE SLIP.
When the lights flash on again—
Wha— who— how...?
That girl! SHE IS the leader of the invasion!
SEIZE THEM!
Eh...? What the? HELP!
Captain Marvel! Do something!!
FIGHT!
It's no use, Mr. Morris! I can't... fight... WOMEN!
THEN THROW HIM INTO THE PIT!! We shall see if he's any braver when he FACES, and FIGHTS, the monster FLESMIH!
I don't know what's come over me! I don't usually let anyone toss me around like this!
Well, at least I'm getting used to this topsy-turvy world enough so that I can land right-side up again!
WE WANT FLESMIH!
Turn loose the monster!
FIGHT! He'll fight FLESMIH!
FLESMIH!
Ah! Maybe this FLESMIH fellow will be something I can really let myself go at! Wonder what he looks like?
NO! NO! It— it CAN'T be! Why— this is... UTTERLY IMPOSSIBLE!
Even the indomitable Captain Marvel pales at the first sight of the horrible monster turned loose on him!
Come on, you overgrown nightmare! I'M READY FOR YOU!
Now I've got you...! OOPS! Where did he go?
OH! Now you're all swelled up! Think you're too smart for me, do you?
BLAST YOU! Why don't you keep one shape till I can catch you?
Ah! THAT'S IT! HOLD THAT POSE! Chin just a little higher— HERE IT COMES—
The whole universe seems to explode in one mighty blast of energy as Captain Marvel finally connects with the jaw of Flesmih!
H-Holy Moley! I've overslept! I've just got five minutes to dress and get to the office!
